name: Lysevatten - Hasteröd
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Lysevatten toward Hasterod, mostly on forest path, dirt/gravel road and short asphalt/road-walk sections; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 10. Lysevatten - Hasteröd
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Lysevatten - Hasteröd.
Official WST slug is 10-lysevatten-hasterod.
Official distance is 12 km / 12000 m.
Official estimated time is 4-5 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.

Stage runs from Lysevatten in Stenungsund toward Hasterod in Lilla Edet.

The route passes commercial forestry and clear-felled areas.
Djupevatten is highlighted as the key stop, suitable for break, overnight stay and swimming.
